title: Proper direct image of bounded-below ind-constructible complexes
statement:
Use the standing scheme setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], as in the proper-heart bound used by the source: $\ell$ is prime, $k$ has characteristic $p_0>0$ with $p_0\ne\ell$, $X,Y$ are separated finite-type $k$-schemes and $p$ is a $k$-morphism. The coefficients $E$ and $\Qlb$ have their condensed meanings [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]. For $T=X,Y$, modules are the internal modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] over $\Lambda_T$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], and $D(T,\Lambda)$ is their unbounded derived category [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories], with cohomology [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. Write $\IndCons(T,\Lambda)$ for the replete small filtered-colimit closure in this module category of the finite constant-model constructible sheaves [sk-def-sfb-constructible]; $\Dic(T,\Lambda)$ consists of the derived objects whose every cohomology sheaf is in $\IndCons(T,\Lambda)$. The functor $Rp_*$ is the total right derived functor [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] of the module pushforward [def-sfb-module-lower-star]. Properness is [def-weil-proper-morphism]; geometric fibres and their dimensions mean [def-weil-geometric-fibre] and [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], with the empty fibre of dimension $-\infty$ and $d\in\mathbf Z$ unrestricted.

Let $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$, $p\colon X\to Y$ proper with geometric fibres of dimension $\leq d$, and
$K\in\Dic(X,\Lambda)$ bounded below. Then $\mathcal H^n(Rp_*K)\in\IndCons(Y,\Lambda)$ for all $n$; if $K$
has cohomology in degrees $\geq a$ then so does $Rp_*K$; and if $K$ has cohomology in degrees $\leq b$
then $Rp_*K$ has cohomology in degrees $\leq b+2d+1$.

proof.text: Use the existing Grothendieck instances for pro-etale abelian sheaves [lem-sfb-proetale-sheaves-grothendieck] and their internal module objects [lem-sfb-modobj-grothendieck]. The module pushforward and total right derived functor are [def-sfb-module-lower-star] and [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. For a bounded-below representative, apply [thm-sp-truncation-e2] to obtain positionwise E2 comparisons, page recursion, stable-page comparisons, and finite exhaustive separated abutment filtrations.

source.place: proof, first paragraph: bounded-below representative and hypercohomology spectral sequence

proof.text: For every cohomological degree, apply [sk-lem-proper-heart-bound] to the ind-constructible heart object. Thus every E2 position is in IndCons and all columns above 2d+1 vanish.

source.place: proof, first paragraph: proper-heart bound on E2

proof.text: Induct on exact-couple pages using [def-sp-exact-couple]. Each next page term is the cokernel of the incoming differential lifted from its page term into the outgoing kernel, so [det-ind-heart-kernels-cokernels] propagates IndCons; the same recursion propagates zero terms. The stable-page isomorphisms supplied by [thm-sp-truncation-e2] then give IndCons stable terms positionwise.

source.place: proof, first paragraph: page recursion and stable terms

proof.text: For any property containing zero and closed under short exact extensions, induct down a finite decreasing filtration from its zero end. Apply [thm-sp-truncation-e2] and [det-ind-heart-extensions] to assemble each abutment object from its graded stable-page pieces. For IndCons, zero and kernel/cokernel closure are supplied by [det-ind-heart-kernels-cokernels].

The compatibility of bounded-below and total right-derived functors gives the lower IsGE bound. For the upper IsLE bound, in total degree n>b+2d+1 every nonzero E2 column would have cohomological degree above b, while columns above 2d+1 vanish by [sk-lem-proper-heart-bound]. Zero page positions remain zero through the exact-couple recursion and the finite filtration, proving the upper bound.

proof_origin.place: Both proof paragraphs, implemented by private exact-couple, filtration, and derived-functor helpers.

lean.statement: theorem proper_indConstructible_boundedBelow (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) (k : Type u) [Field k] (p₀ : ℕ) [CharP k p₀] (hp₀ : 0 < p₀) (hpℓ : p₀ ≠ ℓ) (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] (p : X ⟶ Y) [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper p] (d : ℤ) (hd : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim (pullback p (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap (Y.residueField y) (AlgebraicClosure (Y.residueField y)))) ≫ Y.fromSpecResidueField y) : Scheme.{u}) ≤ if 0 ≤ d then (d.toNat : WithBot ℕ∞) else ⊥) (K : DerivedCategory (pulledBackModuleObjects (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X)) (hK : ∀ n : ℤ, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X) ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj K)) (hbelow : ∃ a₀ : ℤ, K.IsGE a₀) : (∀ n : ℤ, ObjectProperty.ind.{u + 1} (IsConstantModelConstructible (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) Y) ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ n).obj ((CondensedRing.lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K))) ∧ (∀ a : ℤ, K.IsGE a → ((CondensedRing.lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K).IsGE a) ∧ (∀ b : ℤ, K.IsLE b → ((CondensedRing.lowerStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).rightDerivedFunctor.obj K).IsLE (b + 2 * d + 1))
lean.note: The two statements instantiate the canonical condensed finite intermediate field and finite-subextension-valued algebraic-closure rings. Dic and IndCons are expressed directly using the existing cohomology functor, finite constant-model predicate and ObjectProperty.ind; no arbitrary predicate or pushforward is assumed. The geometric fibre bound uses the canonical algebraic closure of each residue field and sends negative integer bounds to bottom, retaining the empty-source case.
